name: github-proxy-slot
title: proxy: dedicated GitHub proxy slot (set --github) for upgrade
description: Config gains a githubProxy slot (civ proxy set --github <url>) that applies only to civ upgrade traffic, so GitHub can be relayed through a different (e.g. acceleration) proxy than civitai; civitai slot semantics unchanged; status/get report both scopes with additive JSON.
